title: Existing restaurant & bar adds a covered terrace (expansion) — Carolina, coastal zone (zone X)
description: Our existing restaurant and bar in Isla Verde, Carolina, plans an expansion: adding a 600 square foot covered terrace for outdoor seating. We already serve alcohol.

mustInclude.rationale: An expansion (ampliacion) of a building needs a construction permit under Ley 161-2009 / RC-2023; no KB rule keys on project_type=expansion (RULE_0643/0644 cover new_construction/renovation only).
RULE_0708: construction-type work at a pin in the coastal zone (location.czm) -> coastal-zone review (the rule itself flags EXPERT VALIDATION NEEDED). (KB: RULE_0708)

Carolina is an autonomous municipality with its own Oficina de Permisos (delegated jerarquia under the Codigo Municipal, Ley 107-2020): the construction permit may be issued by the municipality, so the card should name it (or 'OGPe / Municipio'). Expert: confirm Carolina's current delegation level.

mustNotInclude.rationale: Existing business: normalizeEntityFormationRequirements never adds formation steps for existing_business / project_only, and entityNotFormed is false.
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT] (use permit after construction).
